Sam S.: Hi team, customer reported a billing spike — their local SDK estimator shows ~120 tokens but invoice shows ~450. They're using our JS SDK and streaming. Any quick ideas?
Maria (Billing): Can you paste the exact request/headers and whether they used function/tool calls? Those usually explain hidden tokens.
Sam S.: Repro snippet they sent: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Find the top repo for async batching"}],"tools":[{"name":"code_search","inputs":{"query":"async batching"}}],"stream":true}'```
Sam S.: They say SDK estimator reported only the user+prompt tokens, not system or tool outputs.
Nina L.: Streaming can cause mismatch if the client stops counting at stream cutoff. Also estimators often ignore server-inserted system messages and any tool outputs that arrive after initial tokenization.
Maria (Billing): @Nina good call. Customer also has a prefix system message that our runtime sometimes augments with a short telemetry/system note — those are billable but invisible to client tokenizer.
Alex R.: MeteringBot: note recorded -> metering.debug_level=2 for request id in logs.
Sam S.: Added log id: req_20260321_9b7c. From logs I can see an extra assistant 'tool' message with ~220 tokens returned after function execution. That explains the delta.
Maria (Billing): Can you confirm whether their SDK estimator supports counting tool outputs? Historically the SDK estimator only counts local messages and the final assistant chunk, not intermediate tool responses.
Sam S.: They used SDK v1.2.0 (client estimator built-in).
Nina L.: v1.2.0 estimator explicitly excludes messages with role: \"tool\" and also ignores server-side system insertions. We added a warning in the changelog but customers miss it.
Maria (Billing): Two action items: 1) short-term — tell the customer to compare against /v1/usage/detail or enable X-Redwood-Metering: full header to get server breakdown. 2) longer-term — make estimator opt-in to include tool/system tokens.
Sam S.: I'll send repro steps to customer: set header `X-Redwood-Metering: verbose` and call `/v1/usage/last_request?req_id=req_20260321_9b7c`.
Alex R.: Quick eng note: the runtime sometimes appends a small system sentinel when tools are used (\"--- tool output followup ---\"). It lives server-side and is included in metering but not in the serialized conversation returned to the client until streaming completes. That creates transient estimator gaps.
Nina L.: For immediate mitigation we can: 1) add a telemetry flag in SDK to optionally include server-inserted system tokens in estimator math, 2) document tool-output counting behavior prominently.
Maria (Billing): I've updated the support ticket with the meter breakdown and flagged billing impact. Ticket# INC-47821. Customer asked for estimate of overcharge; we need exact token counts from pipeline.
Sam S.: Got the exact counts from logs: prompt: 68, system/server-inserted: 40, tool-output: 220, completion streaming overhead: 2 => total 330 (their invoice rounded to 334 with other minor items).
MeteringBot: automated note -> Billing pipeline matched server totals and will not revise invoice; charge is valid per TOS.
Maria (Billing): Please share repro with customer and recommend SDK upgrade to the new estimator when released. Also offer a bill credit review if they escalate.
Sam S.: Shared repro and included `curl` + the `X-Redwood-Metering: verbose` header. Customer confirmed they can reproduce and see the extra 220 tool tokens. They were initially misled by the SDK estimator.
Nina L.: I'll open an internal eng ticket to add an opt-in estimator flag and a doc PR. @Alex R. can you own the runtime note about not appending system sentinel until final stream flush?
Alex R.: On it, created ENG-ops-1054.
Maria (Billing): Closing loop with customer: explained why counts differ and next steps. They appreciated the prompt support but asked for clearer SDK doc. :thumbsup:
Sam S.: Thanks all. Marking thread resolved from support side.
